title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of type 1 diabetes and recent hypoglycemia.

HPI
The patient is a known patient with type 1 diabetes mellitus presenting for a routine follow-up. The patient reports experiencing a recent hypoglycemic episode while at work. They describe feeling shaky and lightheaded but were able to treat the event with a fast-acting carbohydrate. The patient reports consistent adherence to their insulin regimen and has not experienced any other significant issues with blood glucose fluctuations this month.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Neurological exam is unremarkable. Skin is intact with no signs of infection. Vital signs are stable.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus.
2. Hypoglycemia.

Plan
The patient will continue the current insulin therapy. We discussed monitoring for further episodes of hypoglycemia and the importance of carrying fast-acting glucose sources. The patient will return to the clinic in three months for a follow-up.
explanations: Type 1 diabetes with hypoglycemia without coma: E10.649.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
